column12: The ExpiWell App will prompt you to answer questions 6 times per day, for 7 consecutive days, starting tomorrow. We are interested in your immediate experience, not your experience 5 or 10 minutes in the past.One day after you complete all of the ExpiWell prompts, you will receive an invitation code for receiving your SONA credits.
column13: Important Notes:Do not respond to the prompts while you are driving, or while involved in any task that requires using your hands for safety. We do not want to endanger you, so please take caution!
